tasks.label: Fix COMPILER_BARRIER macro
tasks.command:
python3 << 'PYEOF'
import re
path = 'app/src/main/cpp/ram_benchmark.c'
with open(path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    content = f.read()
# Remove any existing broken or correct #define COMPILER_BARRIER line(s)
content = re.sub(r'#define COMPILER_BARRIER[^\n]*\n(?:e\([^\n]*\n)?', '', content)
# Insert clean define after the now_ns closing brace block
# Find the end of the now_ns function and the following blank line
insert_after = '    return (int64_t)ts.tv_sec * 1000000000LL + (int64_t)ts.tv_nsec;\n}\n'
clean_define = insert_after + '\n/* COMPILER_BARRIER: memory clobber prevents -O3 from hoisting clock reads */\n#define COMPILER_BARRIER() do { __asm__ volatile("" ::: "memory"); } while (0)\n'
content = content.replace(insert_after, clean_define, 1)
with open(path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    f.write(content)
print('Done - verify:')
import subprocess
result = subprocess.run(['grep', '-n', 'COMPILER_BARRIER', path], capture_output=True, text=True)
print(result.stdout[:500])
PYEOF

tasks.label: Rebuild and commit MemCopy fix
tasks.command:
cd /home/flux/repos/finalbenchmark-platform && ./gradlew assembleDebug 2>&1 | tail -5 && cp app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk /sdcard/Download/finalbenchmark-debug.apk && echo 'DEPLOYED OK' && git add -A && git commit -m 'fix: nativeMemCopy dead-store elim via noinline do_memcpy_once wrapper

- Clang -O3 inlines memcpy(dst, src, CONST) and eliminates it as dead store
  since dst is never read back, causing 875 TB/s bogus result
- Add __attribute__((noinline)) do_memcpy_once() wrapper with asm r(dst)
  constraint to force compiler to treat destination as observable
- Switch from unreliable while(now_ns()<end_ns) to calibrated fixed-REPS
  block timing to eliminate the spin-if-memcpy-is-nop failure mode
- Also fix COMPILER_BARRIER() to do{...}while(0) form' && git push
